text:
Thanks Ron.

I don't think I raised a bad word against you, and you seem a very decent fellow.

I actually really appreciate the national impact of some of the actions you've taken as Governor of Florida - some of which set the tone for other leaders to follow.

I don't agree that you gave voice to "the forgotten". That would require you be more clearly against all mass immigration - legal as well, such as the H1B, OPT abuses & H4 Obama Executive Order - and for a full Immigration Moratorium.

I've been saying it for years now - and anyone who after 2016 dropped this mantra:

"Immigration Immigration Immigration"

has lost touch what is either at the root of all of our problems; and makes the rest un-fixable - until it is slashed to almost nothing.

To do this requires going up against the traditional Mass Migration RINO Lobbyists like Lindsey Graham, John Cornyn, Mike Lee, James Lankford, Kevin Cramer & Thom Tillis.

Among others waiting in the wings to pass Amnesty like Marco Rubio & Maria Salazar.

& Who says No One should Ever try to touch Social Security & Medicare - especially without saying "Whatever happens, older folks who have paid into it will get paid back".

Who - again unlike Little Vivékh - has the Willpower to Crush the Deep State & DC Lavender Mafia & most of all - drive Karen & her Servants utterly mad.

& Finally, who is really the only one that we can ever believe will enact the Make America Great Again for Americans - by deporting all Illegal Migrants ... not just "Biden's 15 million".

Godspeed to you and your Family.

& God Bless Florida. I look foward to seeing you support the Great Deportation - even if your Donors don't like it.
